up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the target with chembl_id 'CHEMBL3717'. Output columns: exact IC50 value (standard_value in nM), canonical SMILES, compound key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay description, and target preferred name. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs. Apply filters: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_relation = '=', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). Do not apply a LIMIT.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_details FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
